allocator_metric_definition.requested_event_bytes: cumulative successful alloc/realloc requested sizes during the phase
allocator_metric_definition.live_bytes_delta: phase-end live-byte change from the pre-phase allocator baseline
allocator_metric_definition.peak_live_bytes: maximum live-byte increase above that baseline during the phase
allocator_metric_definition.rss: separate process VmRSS snapshots where available
